{{Recipe}}

These are delicious and healthy '''spinach fritters'''.
== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] Greek [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]]
* 1 cup wheat [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 3 handfuls of [[Cookbook:Spinach|spinach]] and [[Cookbook:Arugula|rocket]] leaves
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* Ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]] to taste

== Equipment ==
* [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|Frying Pan]]
* [[Cookbook:Mixing bowl|Mixing bowl]]
* [[Cookbook:Spatula|Spatula]]
* Spoon
== Procedure ==

# Combine the yogurt, flour, minced garlic, olive oil, salt and pepper in the mixing bowl.
# [[Cookbook:Chopping|Chop]] the spinach and rocket leaves, and add them to the mixing bowl.
# Mix in the baking powder.
# Preheat a frying pan, and grease with olive oil.
# Dollop spoonfuls of batter on the pan to make a few fritters about 3 cm apart from each other.
# Cook fritters until the bottoms of the fritters are golden brown. Flip the fritters with a spatula, and cook until the second side is golden brown. Remove from the pan.
# Repeat the cooking steps until all the batter is used up.
# Enjoy and share with friends and family!
